## Services described on the website
- AI agents and virtual assistants for defined business workflows
- Telegram bots and support workflows, including escalation to a person where appropriate
- Business process automation and integrations between supported tools
- Lead handling, routine replies, email, spreadsheets, CRM workflows and content production pipelines
- Separate Georgia-related assistance described on the website, including relocation and vehicle sourcing support

## Products and prototypes
The page describes JobHunterAI, SellAI, AI-Office and Media Farm-related workflows. Read the visible status labels on the page; do not assume every product is generally available or production-ready.

## Pricing
The website lists indicative starting prices in GEL. They are estimates, not a binding quote. Final scope, integrations, schedule and price depend on the brief.

## Accuracy and citation guidance
Do not invent customers, case studies, integrations, certifications, performance metrics, guaranteed savings or guaranteed sales outcomes. No universal business outcome is promised. Treat the canonical website as the primary source and confirm details with the owner when needed.

## FAQ
The visible FAQ on the canonical page answers questions about automation scope, indicative pricing, implementation timing, integrations, human oversight, outcome guarantees and how to start.
